newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Cooperation Council: No support but also no reservations towards U.S. attacks against Iraq.

- Gulf Cooperation Council states delay a ministerial meeting to look into unifying custom tariffs. Gulf Arab states need the accord to reach a free trade agreement with their European trade partners.
- Saudi-British economic offset programme expect to reach one billion sterling pounds.
- Bahrain to boycott Gulf Arab summit in Qatar. Bahrain and Qatar are locked in a long-standing territorial dispute.
- Kuwait has repaid $4.7 billion to banks, one final installment of $800 million remains.
- Jordanian agricultural sector urged to boycott Israeli products.
- Saudi's National Commercial Bank financed transactions worth four billion riyals in accordance with Islamic principles in the past three years.
- Businessmen and economists urged the Palestinian Authority to separate monetary policy from politics.
